title: StockSmart Program Allowance in the Step Room of a Commercial Credit Account
content:
On a permanent increase of a Commercial Credit Account, the customer's StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program programs add an allowance to **the step room**.

### Clause

A StockSmart program allowance is added to the step room from the customer's StockSmart programs: when a program fee is dated two whole months before today, the allowance is the program fees billed across those programs in the last three whole months; when none is dated that far back but program fees were billed less than two whole months before today, it is the fees billed in that time plus one month's minimum commitment, the largest monthly minimum fee among the customer's active StockSmart programs; and when no program fee was billed in the last three whole months, it is the minimum commitment for those three months, three times that largest monthly minimum fee, which is nothing when the customer has no active StockSmart program.

Program fees are every program fee charged on the programs — monthly minimum, onsite management and event fees alike. Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the fee date and today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the fee date's day; the last three whole months are the 3 months less than three whole months before today. The monthly minimum fee of an active program is the monthly minimum fee of its StockSmart tier.

### Method by billing history

| Program fees on the customer's programs | Allowance |
|---|---|
| a fee dated two whole months before today | the program fees billed in the last three whole months |
| none that far back; fees billed less than two whole months before today | those fees plus one largest active monthly minimum fee |
| no fee billed in the last three whole months | three times the largest active monthly minimum fee (nothing with no active program) |

### Examples (hypothetical)

- Fees of 400.00 in each of the three months: allowance 1200.00.
- A program started last month with fees of 250.00 billed so far, largest active monthly minimum 250.00: allowance 500.00.
- No fee billed in three months, one active program with a monthly minimum fee of 150.00: allowance 450.00.
